AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving animal products.

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)

   B. Overgrazing continuously

   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

17. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

18. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)

   B. pascal (Pa)

   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
